mathematical_meanings: Left image: The hollow circle marks a hole in the plotted curve. Right image: The outline is the circumcircle of the inscribed square.
Rationales: The feature marks an ordered pair excluded from the plotted trace in the left image and traces the circumference of a geometric circle in the right image. The hollow circle on the red trace at x = 1, above the corresponding filled point. The single outer circle passing through all four corners of the tilted square.
